## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**, with bonus marks on top.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Quizzes</th><td class="big">54</td><td>Four closed-book quizzes; your <strong>best three</strong> count, 18 marks each. No makeup quizzes: a quiz missed for any reason scores zero.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Assignments</th><td class="big">40</td><td>Four or five group assignments of varying weight (for example, some 10 marks and some 12), each with at least one project-like question. Some involve pull requests to public repositories or demos in the style of Hugging Face Spaces. Each is followed by a viva.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Attendance</th><td class="big">6</td><td>See the table below.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

### Assignment marks {#assignment-marks}

```{=html}
<table class="t att" style="max-width:340px" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Part</th><th>Share</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Code runs correctly and solves the problem</td><td>50%</td></tr><tr><td>Questions on the assignment and your code</td><td>25%</td></tr><tr><td>Code quality</td><td>12.5%</td></tr><tr><td>Questions on the theory behind it</td><td>12.5%</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

All members of a group get the same grade. There are no extensions. In the viva, the TAs check that the code matches your submission (any change from it draws a warning), run it, and ask questions: about three quarters on the assignment and a quarter on the theory behind it.

### Attendance {#attendance}

```{=html}
<table class="t att" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Absences</th><th>Marks</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>≤ 3</td><td>6</td></tr><tr><td>4–5</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td>6–7</td><td>4</td></tr><tr><td>8–9</td><td>3</td></tr><tr><td>10–11</td><td>2</td></tr><tr><td>≥ 12</td><td>0</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

If you are going to miss a class, fill in the [leave form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1efg5pt10GssAmyxIF83reFc5rQslRH4mI-yng7XXZ78/edit) and email TA Isha Narang to check the status of your request.

### Bonus marks {#bonus}

Up to 1.5 marks for answering questions in class (0.5 per question, at most three times), at the instructor's discretion. A Kaggle-like competition adds a bonus by final standing (subject to change):

```{=html}
<table class="t att" style="max-width:340px" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Result</th><th>Bonus</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Participation</td><td>0.5</td></tr><tr><td>50th percentile</td><td>1.0</td></tr><tr><td>75th percentile</td><td>1.5</td></tr><tr><td>90th percentile</td><td>2.0</td></tr><tr><td>95th percentile</td><td>2.5</td></tr><tr><td>Top 3</td><td>3.0</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

## Quizzes {#quizzes}

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Quiz</th><th>When</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>1</td><td>03 Sep</td></tr>
<tr><td>2</td><td>Mid-semester exam week, 27 Sep – 04 Oct</td></tr>
<tr><td>3</td><td>29 Oct (planned)</td></tr>
<tr><td>4</td><td>End-semester exam week, 23–29 Nov</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

Quizzes are closed book, with no notes, and may mix multiple-choice and written questions. Two of the four are held in the mid- and end-semester exam slots; there is no separate mid- or end-semester exam. Answer sheets are returned within four to five working days.
